Directory research 2026-10-04: Same act as the solo 'Evan Kuriga' listings at The Villager (the Villager's second listedOn URL is a solo night); the 'Band' is his full-band lineup. No official website found. The YouTube channel is Evan's personal artist channel (last uploads several years old). Its About links point to facebook.com/Evan-kuriga and instagram.com/Evan-Kuriga, but those handles look malformed (Instagram does not allow hyphens), so they were not recorded. No band logo or own-site photos found. An AllMusic credit for an 'Evan Kuriga' on metal releases (Eternity Fallen, Wicked Maraya) may be the same person but is unconfirmed.
description: Band led by Long Island singer and guitarist Evan Kuriga. Mostly covers of pop, rock, soul and R&B songs by artists like the Beatles, Michael Jackson and Stevie Wonder, plus a few of his own songs.

evidence.note: The Villager (Farmingdale) lists 'Live Music: Evan Kuriga Band' on Friday Oct 9, 2026, 6-9 PM; it also lists solo 'Evan Kuriga' nights.

YouTube channel 'Evan Kuriga' describes a singer/songwriter from Long Island, New York, with cover videos (older uploads).
